source.section: Schedule M line 34 Social Security Benefits, 100% at or under the AGI limit and 65% above it for 2025 (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.17; Tax Division Social Security Modification page); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Married filing separately (spouses lived together all year), age 60: the AGI limit is 50,000, so 65%; tax on Rate Schedule II. filer born 1965-09-09, age 60 at December 31, 2025. Federal taxable Social Security (IRS worksheet, given): other income 45,000.00 + half of benefits 6,000.00 = provisional income 51,000.00; married separate living together, base 0: 85% x 51,000.00 = 43,350.00, limited to 85% of benefits 10,200.00: 10,200.00. Federal AGI (given) = wages 45,000.00 + taxable Social Security 10,200.00 = 55,200.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 55,200.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 39,450.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 55,200.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M Column A: line 34(a) total benefits 12,000.00, (b) exempt for federal 1,800.00, (c) taxable 10,200.00; federal AGI 55,200.00 exceeds 50,000.00, so line 34 = 0.65 x 10,200.00 = 6,630.00; line 47: age 60, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 6,630.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 6,630.00. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 6,630.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 55,200.00 + 0.00 - 6,630.00 = 48,570.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 48,570.00 - 2,000.00 = 46,570.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule II (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 5,000.00 = 111 + 2.96% x 7,500.00 = 222 + 3.33% x 7,500.00 = 249.75 + 4.44% x 10,000.00 = 444 + 4.82% x 16,570.00 = 798.674; total 1825.424 = 1,825.42. The booklet rounds to the whole dollar (1,825); expected keeps the cents. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 1,825.42.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
